title: Choose Lean Minimal
question: Figure stays as Look default. Minimal is the airplane instrument: roll, pitch, and steer while riding. Spectate keeps bank and hides pitch and steer.

options.label: Ladder
options.thesis: A fighter HUD pitch ladder. Pitch is the tape you fly; a bank chevron rolls with the bike; steer is a 2px hairline under it.
options.viewport: Portrait plaque. Vertical white pitch ladder, 0 as a horizon hairline at mid. Orange inverted-V chevron banked 32° with a skew 32° bug. Steer hairline and 30% along the bottom.
options.risk: Can look like a military HUD bolted onto a moto overlay if the ticks get dense.

raised.raise: Zero pitch is a horizon hairline through the ladder, not just another tick.

options.label: Tape
options.thesis: Two aircraft tapes. Roll on the left, pitch on the right, steer as the third hairline that already lives on Figure.
options.viewport: Square plaque, vertical hairline. Left: dim ROLL, orange 32° bug, white tick tape. Right: dim PITCH, orange fill up 30%. Bottom spanning both: 2px steer hairline and 30%.
options.risk: Three instruments in one box can force reading instead of a glance.

options.label: Attitude
options.thesis: The airplane bar: a circular attitude indicator. The world tilts. Steer stays a 2px hairline under the gyro.
options.viewport: Square plaque. Circle: pale sky over night-ink ground, white horizon, bank ticks on the rim, orange wing bar banked 32° and pitched up, skew 32° bug. Steer hairline and 30% under the circle.
options.risk: The round gyro can eat the small overlay box and leave steer as an afterthought.
